review_method: Same-assistant source-based first pass and targeted browser fixtures. This is not independent editorial or assistive-technology approval.
state: Batches 01 through 05, not a final release

chapters.title: What HTML does
chapters.review_note: Structure/presentation/script responsibilities and hyperlink choice cross-checked. The catalogue URL is illustrative, not a bundled destination.

chapters.title: Reading a Living Standard
chapters.review_note: Living Standard, authoring versus implementation and obsolete-content answer cross-checked. Missing assigned historical context is supplied in the candidate, sourced to the non-normative history section.

chapters.title: From source to page
chapters.review_note: Parser timing, current DOM and textContent behavior cross-checked. Added DOM Standard ownership. The browser View Source command itself was not exercised.

chapters.title: Elements, tags and attributes
chapters.review_note: Anchor syntax, attributes, comment confidentiality and stated answer cross-checked. No secret belongs in delivered comments.

chapters.title: Think in trees
chapters.review_note: Parent/child/sibling/descendant answer checked against the actual example and DOM tree definitions. Added DOM Standard source.

chapters.title: Make your first document
chapters.review_note: Document title versus h1, UTF-8 shell and local-file/server distinction checked. Title and heading assertions executed.

chapters.title: The document shell
chapters.review_note: Short doctype, one document shell and first-1024-byte meta requirement checked against definitions. Exercise answer remains supported.

chapters.title: html, head and body
chapters.review_note: Head versus header/body and language inheritance checked. Added the exact language-attribute definition.

chapters.title: Text, encoding and escaping
chapters.review_note: Escaping, quote references, literal code and double-escaping answer checked. Candidate formats the complete source answer as inline code and adds transport-encoding diagnostics.

chapters.title: Nesting and void elements
chapters.review_note: Nesting, void/self-closing distinctions and paragraph/div recovery checked. Candidate adds a sourced li omission example; all optional-tag conditions are not yet individually taught/reviewed.

chapters.title: Attributes and their values
chapters.review_note: Boolean presence versus valid syntax and enumerated states checked. Candidate adds permitted boolean spellings, all three default types and the disabled-fieldset caveat.

chapters.title: Content categories and models
chapters.review_note: Anchor/button descendant restrictions and transparent context checked. Exact anchor and button definition sources added. Full per-element category reconciliation remains open.

chapters.title: Conformance and useful errors
chapters.review_note: Conformance-versus-behavior distinction and endpoint answer checked. A checker cannot establish server success, alternative-text quality or WCAG conformance.

chapters.title: Headings and paragraphs
chapters.review_note: Heading hierarchy/conventional single-h1 answer checked. Added hgroup, current outline authoring requirements, inclusive offset/reset algorithm outline and compatibility caution. Runtime reflection differs across tested builds; no broad accessibility support claim.

chapters.title: Inline meaning
chapters.review_note: Stress/importance answer checked. Added defining-instance conditions and exact title/sole-abbr/text precedence; distinguished inline quotations and routed s teaching to CH20.

chapters.title: Code and technical text
chapters.review_note: Escaping answer checked. Added meaningful sub/sup, pre immediate-newline parsing and nested keyboard input. Tested actual DOM text, not merely visual appearance.

chapters.title: Links that go somewhere
chapters.review_note: Navigation/action answer checked and extended for base. Qualified fragment-only targets and explained relative versus root URL/property behavior. Actual native fragment navigation exercised.

chapters.title: Lists with a reason
chapters.review_note: Corrected ordered-list answer: meaningful order is not necessarily procedural steps. Added menu limits, wrapped dl groups, multi-paragraph values and reversed/value behavior boundaries.

chapters.title: Figures and captions
chapters.review_note: Figure/alternative answer checked. Supplied an original fictional SVG at a working publication-relative path, inspected its rendering and compared room relationships with alt/caption. Added caption placement and diagram-specific exercise. No independent image-accessibility review.

chapters.title: Dates, values and edits
chapters.review_note: Date precision answer checked. Added abbr with visible expansion, plural agreement and independent metadata, and differentiated time values from edit timestamp syntax. Invalid bare-time edit fixture rejected by Nu.

chapters.title: Language and direction
chapters.review_note: Untrusted-name answer checked. Added wbr, ruby/rp and explicit bdo direction requirement; checked text, CSS direction and reference decoding, not actual assistive-technology pronunciation.

chapters.title: Containers and grouping
chapters.review_note: Generic-wrapper answer checked. Removed unsupported fictional-dialable-number placeholder instead of inventing a reserved number. Added quotation and visible attribution boundaries.

chapters.title: Sections that have a subject
chapters.review_note: Section decision answer checked against the named-region mapping. Clarified visible heading versus accessible name and landmark overuse. No OS assistive-technology run.

chapters.title: Articles and supporting content
chapters.review_note: Aside answer checked. Added contextual header/footer mappings and address restrictions, with direct HTML-AAM citations.

chapters.title: Navigation and main content
chapters.review_note: Navigation-label answer checked and extended for the main hidden-attribute rule. Native skip-link focus tested in three engines. Main placement and search semantics clarified.

chapters.title: Tables that explain the data
chapters.review_note: Table answer checked and extended for explicit header ids and zero row spans. Added column-group structure, span limits, same-table th targets and cellIndex caveat. No complex-table assistive-technology approval.

chapters.title: Plan a small site
chapters.review_note: Relative-path answer checked with resolved URL fixtures. Clarified deployment prefixes and aria-current versus disabled state without changing hosting.

chapters.title: Images with a purpose
chapters.review_note: Alternative/context exercise checked. Replaced missing photo with supplied schematic; added complete/decoding failure distinction, preference defaults and CORS boundary. Broken-image decode fixture executed in three engines.

chapters.title: Responsive image choices
chapters.review_note: Art-direction answer checked and extended for CSS versus sizes. Supplied three correctly dimensioned PNGs and complete matching-layout markup. Fresh-context resource selections observed without exact-filename guarantees.

chapters.title: Audio, video and tracks
chapters.review_note: Transcript placement answer checked and extended for default-track limits. Supplied actual WebM/MP4, a WebVTT sound cue and descriptive transcript. All three engines decoded WebM and loaded/activated the cue; no human listening or OS AT approval.

chapters.title: Image maps
chapters.review_note: Geometry exercise checked and extended. Coordinates now enclose a real supplied schematic region and reach a real fragment, verified by pointer and keyboard. Added shape, map-name/id and fixed-geometry boundaries.

chapters.title: Embedding another document
chapters.review_note: Permissions exercise checked and extended for srcdoc precedence. Replaced missing preview file with an actual static srcdoc notice; verified embedded text. Clarified injection, CSP, Permissions Policy and object/embed fallback; lab restrictions not weakened.

chapters.title: Canvas, SVG and MathML
chapters.review_note: Alternative-data exercise checked and extended for cross-origin export. Retained assigned API scope rather than treating signatures or introductory integration as completion. Executed namespaces, default bitmap/reset, incompatible context, tainted export and successful CORS export fixtures.

chapters.title: How forms send data
chapters.review_note: Entry-list answer checked and extended. Added repeated entries, submitters, output exclusion, empty files, dirname and charset special handling. Added owning XHR FormData source and tested reentrant InvalidStateError.

chapters.title: Labels and groups
chapters.review_note: Group-label exercise checked and extended for form-owner boundaries. Tightened radio grouping explanation, label association, first-legend exception and fieldset form non-inheritance. Selected entry/exclusion relationships tested; no OS AT run.

chapters.title: Text, email and passwords
chapters.review_note: Email verification answer checked and extended for telephone state. Added state-specific URL/email behavior, autocomplete purposes and sanitization boundaries; no mailbox delivery or picker usability claim.

chapters.title: Numbers, dates and colour
chapters.review_note: Quantity/date answer checked and extended for empty-number NaN. Added month/week/time units, step bases, valueAsDate/valueAsNumber exception boundaries, range defaults and color-extension keywords/defaults. Scoped API tests passed; color reflection differs between engines.

chapters.title: Choices, files and hidden values
chapters.review_note: Missing-checkbox answer checked and extended for default on/file setter restrictions. Added current/default checked distinctions, file metadata/storage limits and OWASP upload source. Deliberately fictional file bytes were submitted only to a local receiver; chooser/server safety not inferred.

chapters.title: Menus and longer text
chapters.review_note: Datalist answer checked and extended for selectedcontent cloning. Added exact placeholder context, selected/default states, textarea wrapping and selectedcontent structure/label distinction. Chromium/WebKit reflected selected content; Firefox retained tag but did not implement the observed updates. Nu has recorded CSS/context limitations.

chapters.title: Validation people can recover from
chapters.review_note: Custom-validity correction answer checked and extended for meter/progress. Added pattern v mode/full-value behavior, length constraints, invalid-event boundary, output reset/submission/validation rules and real gauge fixtures. Genuine keyboard short-input correction tested.

chapters.title: Submission and server boundaries
chapters.review_note: Service-boundary answer checked and extended for submitter exceptions. Added UTF-8 authoring, named-property collisions, bypass flags and dialog submission. Actual local GET, overriding POST and multipart requests inspected; requestSubmit versus submit event/validation behavior tested. No live endpoint or complete security review.

chapters.title: Buttons and commands
chapters.review_note: Corrected reset wording; added contextual Auto/command behavior and input submit/reset/button/image distinctions. Scoped reset and command probes are current; full submitter/API review remains.

chapters.title: Disclosure with details
chapters.review_note: Added same-tree nonempty-name group constraints, summary role/content and queued/coalesced toggle semantics. Native keyboard toggling and exclusivity tested. Nu missed a known-invalid two-open group.

chapters.title: Dialogs and popovers
chapters.review_note: Added a real auto-popover example, explicit dialog focus choice and cancellation/closedby/lifecycle distinctions. Selected modal/popover paths tested, not OS AT or every Hint/close-watcher algorithm.

chapters.title: Focus, editing and dragging
chapters.review_note: Replaced decorative movement buttons with actual local reordering, boundary controls, named actions, focus and visible result. Keyboard and pointer tested; actual native drag/touch/IME paths remain.

chapters.title: Templates and component boundaries
chapters.review_note: Extended fragment/slot/declarative-shadow, cloning/serialization and registration exceptions. Native parser, slot assignment and closed-root reference boundaries tested. Streaming updates/scoped-registry and complete component coverage remain open.

chapters.title: Custom data and structured data
chapters.review_note: Replaced unimplemented Save with a real validated dataset display; reviewed null/deletion/name conversion and microdata value/identifier ownership. Dataset probes tested, not complete extraction or search-consumer approval.

chapters.title: Global attributes in context
chapters.review_note: Added hidden/until-found, inert, punctuated ids, editing/keyboard hints and CSS Shadow Parts ownership. Selected native state/discovery tests performed. Full global applicability and AT review remain.

chapters.title: Element-specific attributes
chapters.review_note: Added contextual index-navigation, handler cancellation and nonce-reflection distinctions. Stored text is not a behavior-support test. Full handler/CSP event-processing coverage remains open.

chapters.title: Metadata readers encounter
chapters.review_note: Aligned metadata with actual fictional body content; added meta/header, base and style authoring boundaries. Current citation/output checks pass; full metadata and response-header review remains.

chapters.title: Resource relationships
chapters.review_note: Replaced missing CSS/icon paths with supplied publication resources; reviewed preload/modulepreload/preconnect and link vocabulary limits. Real stylesheet and matched script-preload request observed, not a performance guarantee.

chapters.title: Loading and policy attributes
chapters.review_note: Supplied a real hashed script and explained strongest-digest, CORS, nonce and referrer boundaries. Scoped local SRI/CORS/CSP/referrer requests tested in three engines; complete security review remains open.

chapters.title: Attributes and properties
chapters.review_note: Added pristine/dirty/default/reset, nonce hiding, form/radio/options collection and legacy document.all distinctions. Selected native states tested; complete conversions/exceptions/member algorithms remain open.

chapters.title: How parsing starts
chapters.review_note: Extended tokenizer/fragment grammar and injection boundaries; native context, unsupported MIME and XML error tests. Full parser/sanitizer/Trusted Types algorithms remain open.

chapters.title: Tree construction and recovery
chapters.review_note: Extended implied row groups, foster parenting, adoption-agency and stream-writing boundaries. Controlled invalid recovery was tested separately from conforming source.

chapters.title: The document lifecycle
chapters.review_note: Extended readiness/task/microtask/restoration distinctions. Controlled blocking/deferred/module/async/load order and checkpoint order tested; no full bfcache/device or timing guarantee.

chapters.title: Scripts and execution
chapters.review_note: Replaced missing script/fallback files with supplied deferred local filtering and an honest static baseline. Dependency/import-map/module scope/MIME/nomodule probes pass. All script-type algorithms remain open.

chapters.title: HTML and XML serialization
chapters.review_note: Extended media-type, namespace/case, empty-element and XML-error behavior. Same bytes served as HTML/XML tested in three engines. No whole XML/serialization approval.

chapters.title: HTML and rendering
chapters.review_note: Replaced absent hours destination with real fictional in-document content. Logical/visual order and mapping boundaries extended; native Tab versus reversed visual order tested.

chapters.title: Where the wider APIs begin
chapters.review_note: Implemented real restore/store/remove and a supplied bounded worker with termination/error/timeout paths. Controlled storage events, history exceptions/traversal, native origin/source messages and buffer transfer tested. Full assigned APIs remain open.

chapters.title: Accessibility starts in the markup
chapters.review_note: Replaced unhandled search with actual local filtering, no-match/reset and non-enhanced baseline. Added naming/ARIA/WCAG task boundaries; no OS AT approval.

chapters.title: Keyboard and focus review
chapters.review_note: Replaced nonfunctional Add button with actual local removal/restore, skip CSS and focus policy. Keyboard skip, next/previous/final removal and restore tested. Actual OS AT/focus usability review remains.

chapters.title: Trust boundaries
chapters.review_note: Extended serialization, origin, CSP/CORS/SRI/Trusted Types and server boundary distinctions. Controlled text versus active-handler injection tested; no complete sanitizer/backend/security approval.

chapters.title: Performance without folklore
chapters.review_note: Replaced absent entrance photo with supplied 800x450 schematic. Qualified hints, metrics, timing exposure and measurement claims; actual decode checked, no speed improvement asserted.

chapters.title: Findable and shareable pages
chapters.review_note: Replaced missing destination/real-policy implication with supplied fictional checklist. Extended canonical/language/discovery/rights boundaries; no indexing/ranking claim.

chapters.title: Maintainable HTML
chapters.review_note: Replaced fake static query endpoint with actual local enhancement and disabled honest fallback. No-script and failed-resource paths tested separately; source/hashed output checked.

chapters.title: A release checklist that means something
chapters.review_note: Extended evidence/gate matrix, semantic PDF tagging/reading order and repository/CI/deployment distinctions. The full tagged PDF and independent approval remain open.

findings.finding: Assigned history topic lacked substantive coverage in the reading edition.
findings.candidate_action: Added a short historical account with dates and source; distinguished non-normative history from authoring requirements.

findings.finding: Exact source answer lacked inline-code formatting; response encoding diagnostics were too brief.
findings.candidate_action: Preserved answer characters inside code formatting and added ordered-detection/transport caveat.

findings.finding: Optional tags were mentioned without a worked conditional omission example.
findings.candidate_action: Added a li sibling example and tested it in three engines. Complete optional-tag registry/reconciliation is still open.

findings.finding: Boolean rendering behavior was described, but valid spellings and the distinction between missing, empty and invalid enumerated defaults needed explicit treatment.
findings.candidate_action: Added valid boolean forms, rejection of true/false as authoring values, three default types and fieldset caveat.

findings.finding: Several explanations relied on broader source routes instead of the defining DOM, language, encoding or control-content definition.
findings.candidate_action: Added exact owning-definition citations, without claiming that link availability proves every assertion correct.

findings.finding: The published editable-preview policy permits a same-origin navigation request, contradicting its blanket no-network wording. No parent-DOM or storage disclosure was demonstrated.
findings.candidate_action: Restricted parent frame-src to about:, narrowed the UI/privacy/PDF/guide wording, added warnings, and tested selected restrictions in three engines.

findings.finding: The released 405-page PDF is 1.4, has no structure tree/marked flag, and has no structured link association.
findings.candidate_action: Diagnosed actual objects and built a separate four-page semantic-export experiment. Full-book tagged export, semantic review, validator and screen-reader checks remain open.

findings.finding: The tagged-export prototype has TH tags but did not preserve explicit Scope metadata in the inspected fixture despite HTML scope attributes.
findings.candidate_action: Recorded table-association verification/remediation as a gate; did not accept engine PDF/UA output settings as proof of conformance.

findings.finding: Assigned elements lacked substantive owner-chapter teaching.
findings.candidate_action: Added worked inline syntax and explanations for hgroup, dfn, sub/sup, menu, abbr, wbr and col/colgroup, plus explicit ruby and definition conditions.

findings.finding: Fragment-only navigation and ordered-list answers were overbroad.
findings.candidate_action: Qualified base-dependent fragment resolution, corrected ordered-list meaning, extended explained exercises and tested resolved hrefs.

findings.finding: New heading offsets, named sections, contextual landmarks and main hidden-state rules needed distinct explanations.
findings.candidate_action: Added normative/source distinctions, compatibility limits and main authoring condition; executed scoped navigation and reflection probes.

findings.finding: An image example had no supplied image, and a fictional phone number was not established as reserved.
findings.candidate_action: Supplied and inspected a clearly fictional original SVG with matching alternative/caption. Removed the dialable teaching placeholder.

findings.finding: Date, span and header relationships needed element-specific constraints.
findings.candidate_action: Distinguished edit timestamps from broader time values; added table span bounds, zero-rowspan semantics, explicit th ids and column-group rules, with positive/negative fixtures.

findings.finding: Multiple media/embedding examples depended on missing resources or illustrative map geometry.
findings.candidate_action: Supplied original raster derivatives, actual video/caption/transcript and measured image-map target; replaced missing iframe preview with static srcdoc.

findings.finding: Assigned output, progress and meter lacked meaningful teaching.
findings.candidate_action: Added purposeful snippets, value/default/reset/submission constraints and actual DOM/API fixtures.

findings.finding: Radio ownership, entry-list cases, state-specific conversions and submission exceptions needed stronger boundaries.
findings.candidate_action: Added explanations and extended answers; executed local entry, exception, native-request and recovery fixtures.

findings.finding: New color and selectedcontent features were named without enough behavior or implementation distinction.
findings.candidate_action: Explained keywords/defaults and selected-option content cloning; recorded differences without universal-support claims.

findings.finding: FormData needed its owning XHR source; Canvas API coverage could be mistaken for an exclusion and security recommendations needed explicit boundaries.
findings.candidate_action: Added XHR and OWASP sources, retained assigned API backlog, and tested controlled tainted versus CORS-enabled export without weakening browser or lab policies.

findings.finding: Nu rejected the tested new CSS opt-in syntax but did not reject selectedcontent in a known-invalid placement.
findings.candidate_action: Separated current HTML checks from runtime CSS probes; retained the invalid fixture and recorded the missed authoring constraint. No blanket validator approval inferred.

findings.finding: Reset was described as clearing and button Auto/command exceptions were underexplained.
findings.candidate_action: Corrected default restoration and contextual submission/invoker distinctions; preserved complete payload/API review as open.

findings.finding: Disclosure-group constraints and dialog/popover cancellation/default lifecycles needed stronger treatment.
findings.candidate_action: Added a real popover and reviewed native details/dialog behavior with scoped focus and cancellation probes.

findings.finding: Movement and Save controls did not implement their implied application actions.
findings.candidate_action: Implemented real pointer/keyboard local reordering and replaced the fake Save with a validated dataset display. No persistence promise.

findings.finding: Metadata described absent details, external teaching resource paths were missing and SRI had no supplied matching resource.
findings.candidate_action: Aligned fictional body/metadata, supplied actual stylesheet/icon references and a real SHA-384 checked teaching script.

findings.finding: Shadow, global-hint and default/current/reflection boundaries needed further teaching.
findings.candidate_action: Expanded source-backed explanations and native state probes; template streaming updates/scoped registries, full members and cross-spec coverage remain explicitly open.

findings.finding: Nu 26.10.12 accepted known-invalid same-name details authored twice open and dialog tabindex markup.
findings.candidate_action: Retained both negative controls and classified the two missed authoring constraints as checker gaps, not valid author markup.

findings.finding: Script/fallback resources and an illustrative image were absent from their teaching examples.
findings.candidate_action: Supplied real local filtering and a dimensioned existing schematic; tested source and hashed compiled assets.

findings.finding: A search form and linked policy destination lacked the implied handler or supplied target.
findings.candidate_action: Implemented local-only filtering with readable no-script/failed-resource baseline; supplied fictional in-document guide rather than a missing real-policy page.

findings.finding: The Add action and skip-link styling did not implement the promised interaction/focus plan.
findings.candidate_action: Supplied actual local removal/restore, focused skip visibility and next/previous/heading focus behavior. OS AT remains open.

findings.finding: Parser, lifecycle and wider-API inventory introductions lacked important contextual/default/exception/lifecycle explanations.
findings.candidate_action: Added substantive source-backed distinctions and scoped native parser, MIME, scheduling, storage, worker, history and messaging probes. Complete algorithms/members remain open.

findings.finding: Accessibility/security/performance and tagged-PDF release claims needed clearer separate evidence contracts.
findings.candidate_action: Expanded actual task/state, trust and measurement boundaries; preserved all independent, exhaustive coverage, security/AT and full-book tagged-PDF gates.
